name: angelica sinensis root + cinnamon + turmeric
purpose: Treat people suffering from neck, shoulder and back pain, as well as leg pain, including problems such as intervertebral disc protrusion, muscle strain and bone spurs.
uses: Apply it to the uncomfortable area, and leave it on for 3-5hours each time.
otcwarn: This is a topical patch meant for external use only.Do not ingest it.Keep out of reach of children to prevent accidental consumption.
